title: Refresh token rotation design
body: Rotation issues a new refresh token on every use and revokes the parent. Reuse of a revoked token invalidates the whole family and forces re-authentication.

title: Session store benchmark: Redis vs Postgres
body: Redis holds p95 issuance latency at 41ms up to 8k rps. Postgres crosses the 600ms budget at 3.2k rps because of lock contention on the session write path.

title: Dual-writer cutover runbook
body: Step-by-step cutover from the legacy session table to Redis, including the queue-depth gauge and the rollback trigger at 5k pending writes.

title: Proration rules for mid-cycle plan changes
body: Upgrades prorate immediately against the remaining period; downgrades queue to the next cycle boundary so credit never exceeds the invoice total.

title: Dunning retry schedule
body: Failed charges retry on days 1, 3, 7 and 14. After the fourth failure the subscription moves to past_due and access is degraded rather than revoked.

title: Realtime presence in the dashboard
body: Presence state is tracked per channel with a 30 second heartbeat. Stale members are swept on the next broadcast rather than on a timer.

title: Row level security cookbook
body: Policies are written against auth.uid() and the request role. The anon role sees only rows explicitly marked public; service_role bypasses every policy.

title: CSV importer post-mortem
body: The importer was retired after the 2025 migration. Kept for the schema mapping table in appendix B.
